newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-MGTS Russia H1 pretax up to 348 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-MGTS Russia H1 pretax up to 348 bln rbls.

text.p: Russian telecommunications company MGTS pretax profits to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis rose to 348.03 billion roubles in the first half of 1997 from 234.04 billion roubles for the same period a year ago, a company statement said on Monday.
Other company financial indicators as of

NOTES -- Full company name is OAO Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telefonnaya Set (MGTS). International auditing firm Coopers and Lybrand prepared the accounts, which are to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis.

As of April this year, MGTS shareholders include telecoms holding company Svyazinvest which owns 47.67 percent of shares, the Moscow City Council on Science and Technology and Co., which holds 33.33 percent of shares, the Bank of Bermuda (Cayman) Ltd, which owns 6.03 percent of shares, CS First Boston, which owns 3.61 percent, and Credit Suisse (Moscow) which owns 2.09 percent of shares.
Definitions of profit and assets differ from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.

Year-on-year consumer price inflation in June 1997 was 14.5 percent, compared with 50.2 percent a year earlier. Prices rose 8.6 percent during the first six months of 1997, against 15.5 percent in the first half of 1996.
